newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-ELWOOD RECALLED TO REVAMPED IRELAND SIDE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ELWOOD RECALLED TO REVAMPED IRELAND SIDE.

text.p: Fly-half Eric Elwood has been recalled to the Ireland side in one of five changes in the team to meet France in the opening round of the Five Nations' championship at Lansdowne Road next Saturday.
Elwood, whose last game for Ireland was against Scotland a year ago, is preferred to Paul Burke, who landed an Irish record eight penalties in the 37-29 defeat by Italy last Saturday.
Maurice Field replaces the injured Mark McCall at centre and Niall Hogan regains his place at scrum-half in place of Steve McIvor.

Paddy Johns takes over from Gabriel Fulcher in the second row while Eric Miller moves from flanker to number eight. Miller started the game against Italy at open-side flanker before being injured and replaced by Denis McBride after 32 minutes.
With McBride keeping his place, Miller will play number eight at the expense of Anthony Foley.

Manager Pat Whelan said former All Black flanker Mike Brewer, now coaching in Ireland, had helped with the selectors' deliberations. Brewer's compatriot Murray Kidd resigned as coach last Tuesday following the Italy defeat.
"Our new training adviser Brian Ashton could not have any input as a selector but before the meeting we did have some discussions with him," Whelan said.
"We are not looking any further than the match against France. Ashton will join us when the team convenes tomorrow and will take charge of the backs at our first training session in Limerick."

Ireland - Conor O'Shea; James Topping, Maurice Field, Jonathan Bell, Dominic Crotty; Eric Elwood, Niall Hogan; Eric Miller, Denis McBride, David Corkery, Jeremy Davidson, Paddy Johns, Paul Wallace, Keith Woods (captain), Nick Popplewell.
